coverage_decomposition_2025.note: new-entrant WAR is covered by the ETA-prospect block and the recentering remainder; the original level gap was the exposure-floor universe (see retro_backtest)

calibration.kind: v2: per-team sub-floor depth pool + cohort intercepts (side x age band, retro-backtest-fit 2022-24, holdout-gated) + small uniform remainder to the 2,430-win league sum, applied per season
limitations: depth-pool team assignment needs a contract row; unassigned depth WAR rides the uniform remainder
spread stays projection-compressed (correct for a mean projection; bands carry the uncertainty)

forward_gate.scope: first season only; 2028+ are not gateable
forward_gate.metric: MAE vs actual wins; baseline = prior-season wins carry-forward

design.no_lookahead: curves + WAR map refit per target on data through Y-1 (Gate-1 pattern)
design.team_assignment: primary actual season-Y team by exposure stint (B-Ref war_daily); isolates engine error from roster churn - disclosed
design.population: every player with >=1 input season in Y-3..Y-1; absent target season scores actual WAR 0; new entrants (rookies/IFA, ~61 WAR/season) are outside the veteran engine and absorbed by the recentering level

ship_decision.challenger: cohort intercepts (side x age band) + recentering

multi_year.kind: controlled-core: each player counts only through his control window (_last_controlled_season); each season is independently recentered to the 2,430-win league sum
multi_year.display_metric: the surface shows year-1 W-L + WAR plus lockedPct = WAR-weighted control share (controlled / everyone-stays WAR over 2027-31); aging cancels, so it isolates cost control
limitations: only the first season (2027) is forward-gateable; out-years (2028+) are a controlled-core competitive trajectory, NOT scored against actual standings
control window = Spotrac signed_through where present, else an age-based proxy (no service time in the pipeline)
cohort intercepts were fit on year-1 residuals; out-year application re-bands by age but is an approximation
